_comment: Single source of truth for the cards on index.html. Run `python3 tools/build-index.py` after editing; it rewrites only the regions between the build markers in docs/index.html. Section order here is the order on the page and in the hero navigation. Icons are inline SVG names from tools/build-index.py, not files.

sections.label: AI
sections.intro: Tools and resources for using generative AI in your teaching, and for understanding what the research says about it.

cards.title: Assignment Redesign for the AI Era
cards.description: An interactive worksheet for redesigning assignments around academic integrity: what students are learning, what successful work looks like, and where AI belongs.

cards.title: AI Petting Zoo
cards.description: A guided, self-paced tour of AI tools and techniques for saving instructors time and enhancing student learning, with example teaching tasks to try.

thumb.aria: Start the AI Petting Zoo tour

cards.title: AI in Education Knowledge Base
cards.description: A research knowledge base on AI in education, with concept pages and study summaries. Also available as the AI in Education Advisor Gem or a NotebookLM notebook.

thumb.aria: Browse the AI in Education Knowledge Base

cards.title: Online Module Designer
cards.description: A custom Gemini Gem for designing online learning modules, from outcomes and activities to assessment.

sections.label: Accessibility
sections.intro: Resources for designing courses and materials that work for every student.

cards.title: Canvas Accessibility Checklist
cards.description: A practical Canvas accessibility checklist built from three questions: start with what students need next, then improve the course as you go.

cards.title: Digital Accessibility for Teaching and Learning
cards.description: An openly licensed book on accessible course design, documents, and media for higher education.

cards.title: Alt Text Generator
cards.description: A custom Gemini Gem for writing alt text, so students who cannot see an image still get the information it carries.

sections.label: Teaching
sections.intro: Canvas courses and checklists for teaching in Canvas, from getting started to teaching online.

cards.title: Canvas Starter Kit
cards.description: An HCC Canvas course for getting started with teaching in Canvas.

cards.title: Evidence-based Teaching in Canvas
cards.description: An HCC Canvas course on evidence-based teaching practices in Canvas.
